audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 0, 5 and 6 read 'Skill' while their own why text says Ziggs pokes you off the wave before you have a combo, your first item spikes your clear and roam pressure, and at 2+ items he out-ranges everything you do.
audit.why: Packet chart is [Ziggs, Skill, Skill, Skill, Neeko, Neeko, Ziggs] and agrees with the prose on all three. Kit numbers back it: Bouncing Bomb is 850 range on 6s at rank 1 against your 800-range Q, so Level 1 is his; his artillery scaling is the late-game reason row 6 is his too.
audit.corrected: Row 0 to Ziggs, row 5 to Neeko, row 6 to Ziggs, as one atomic pair-matched group.

audit.why: Four spikes correctly staged: Lvl 1-2 his range advantage, Lvl 6 Pop Blossom, 1st item Lost Chapter/Liandry's, Late his siege. The Level 6 framing is right for the cooldown maths — his Satchel is 20s at rank 1 against your 120s R, so the ult must be spent on a Satchel that is already gone.

audit.whatIsWrong: Hexplosive Minefield is called 'Minefield' throughout, and none of the three cooldowns that decide this lane appear anywhere.
audit.why: Bouncing Bomb 6/5.5/5/4.5/4s at 850; Satchel Charge 20/18/16/14/12s at 1000, knocking both you and him away; Hexplosive Minefield a flat 16s at 900 with a slow, and repeat detonations on the same target deal reduced damage — so walking one mine field twice hurts less than the page implies. Short Fuse is an auto-attack reset whose cooldown shortens every time he casts, which makes his empowered auto the burst tell rather than any ability animation.
audit.corrected: Full ability name used, real cooldowns written into the lines that gate your commits, and Short Fuse named as the tell.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[2].d calls a spent Satchel Charge a 'fifteen-second invitation'; it is 20/18/16/14/12s.
audit.why: The page names Satchel as the single green light for every commit, so the number attached to it has to be right.

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[1] and the 'early' text both refer to a shield from Neeko's passive absorbing a bomb.
audit.why: Riot's passive text describes only the disguise and the conditions that break it — there is no shield in the description and no shield flag on the ability. I replaced the claim in whys[1] with a verified fact (the Short Fuse reset) rather than leave an invented defensive tool on the page; the same claim in 'early' is logged as unverified rather than rewritten.
audit.corrected: Short Fuse's shortening reset is the real thing to watch in that trade window.

edits.before: His knockback escape — he is catchable only while it is down. Until it’s spent, every commit is a coin flip.
edits.after: Satchel is a 20s knockback escape at rank 1 — until he spends it, every commit of yours is a coin flip.

edits.before: Ziggs burns Satchel Charge on nothing — take the fifteen-second invitation.
edits.after: Ziggs burns Satchel Charge on nothing — that is a 20s invitation at rank 1.

edits.before: Ziggs' Bouncing Bomb (Q) out-ranges your seed (Q) and pokes you off the wave before you have any combo or threat.
edits.after: Bouncing Bomb (Q) is 850 to your 800 and back every 6s at rank 1 — he pokes you off the wave and you have no answer.

edits.before: Even trade — you can chip with Q re-bloom from range and your passive shield eats a bomb, but neither of you can commit a kill.
edits.after: Even trade — chip with Q re-bloom, but Short Fuse (P) recharges faster every time he casts, so his auto is the burst tell.

edits.before: Save Satchel Charge (W) self-knockback and Minefield (E) to deny your E root and break any all-in
edits.after: Save Satchel Charge (W) and Hexplosive Minefield (E) — a flat 16s — to break your all-in root

notes: suspectNames flagged 'Save Satchel Charge' in wants.foe[1] — FALSE POSITIVE; Satchel Charge is the correct name and the detector was matching the leading verb. The genuine naming issue on that line was 'Minefield' for Hexplosive Minefield, which I fixed. Chart rows 0, 5 and 6 proposed as one atomic pair-matched group and now match the packet. Two unverified claims left on the page rather than guessed at: (a) 'the shield from your passive' in content 'early' — Riot's passive text describes only the disguise and its break conditions, with no shield anywhere in the kit, and I only had band room to correct the whys[1] instance; (b) 'Shapesplitter (W) invis' in whys[4], spikes[1], mid, late and wants.you[0] — Riot's W text gives a clone plus bonus damage and move speed, no stealth flag. Both recur across the whole champion and should be settled once at champion level. Also a flag misfire: the kit tags Satchel Charge with percentHealth, but Riot's description says only 'deals magic damage to enemies, knocking them away' — I did not write any percent-health claim.
